observations: Photo 0 shows a single headlight assembly.
The assembly has a clear lens and an orange turn signal lens.
The housing appears to be made of metal.
The bulb socket is visible at the base.
The item is resting on a tiled floor with other parts in the background.

claims.evidence: The model and year are not legible on the housing in photo 0.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The bulb may be burnt out or the socket may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the bulb inside the socket with the lens removed.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal scratches or haze.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens surface with no glare.

risks.risk: The assembly may be missing the mounting bracket or clips.
risks.proof: A photo showing the assembly fully assembled with its mounting hardware.

proof_requests: Photo of the bulb inside the socket.
Photo of the lens surface to check for scratches.
Photo of the assembly with the mounting bracket attached.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
